channel.title: Wager Assistant Blog
channel.description: Sports betting and casino strategy guides from Wager Assistant.

item.title: Sports Betting Tips for Beginners: A Smart Start
item.description: New to sports betting? Learn the core beginner tips: reading odds, bankroll management, shopping for lines, avoiding tilt, and the bets to start with.

item.title: Understanding Betting Odds & Implied Probability
item.description: Learn how American, decimal and fractional odds work, how to convert them, and how to turn any price into implied probability to spot value bets.

item.title: Bankroll Management Strategies for Bettors
item.description: Protect your betting bankroll with proven staking strategies: flat staking, percentage staking, unit sizing and the Kelly Criterion explained simply.

item.title: Blackjack Basic Strategy Tips to Cut the House Edge
item.description: Learn blackjack basic strategy: when to hit, stand, double and split, plus the rules and habits that cut the house edge to around 0.5%.

item.title: Roulette Tips & Odds by Bet Type Explained
item.description: Understand roulette odds, payouts and the house edge for every bet type, why European wheels beat American, and realistic tips for smarter play.

item.title: Craps Best Bets: Lowest House Edge Wagers
item.description: Discover the best bets in craps with the lowest house edge: pass line, don't pass, come bets and free odds, plus the sucker bets to avoid.

item.title: Baccarat Strategy: Smart Bets and the Math
item.description: Learn baccarat strategy the smart way: why the banker bet is best, the real house edges, why the tie is a trap, and how to manage your bankroll.

item.title: Parlay Betting Tips: Rewards, Risks & Smart Play
item.description: Parlay betting tips that balance big payouts with the real risks: how parlay odds multiply, why they favor the book, and how to use them wisely.
